exact_statement: Repair of stage11 raw-mask bank: for a zero-one shared event a, independent Boolean V, F=1+a(V-1), p=Ea, mu=EV,q=1-mu,D=sum |S| ahat(S)^2,J=sum phi(ahat(S)^2), N=H(F)-pH(V), the exact equation (1) of ACTIVATION_PROOF.md holds and 0<=N<=2qJ+5pq, I_shared=2qD, I_private=pI(V). For 0<p<=1/2 and J<=KD, N<=(K+5)I_shared. H(1-2a)<=C I(1-2a) implies N<=(C+13)I_shared. Existence of an absolute all-event coefficient for this admission is equivalent to full FEI. The specified rare-event admission need not be hereditary under shared restrictions. The known bent-splice family has N/I_shared>=k-2 for even k>=4 and so obstructs shared-only payment for two arbitrary nonconstant profiles; no novelty or FEI disproof is claimed.
